description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git format-patch' command, focusing on numbered patch options and output formatting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expectation with setup and verification steps.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks the number of patches with no numbering in a given patch file.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that a patch file contains exactly one patch with no numbering.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that a patch file contains exactly two patches with no numbering.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the patch file has cover letter patches numbered as 0/1 and 1/1.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that the patch file has a single patch numbered 1/1.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Checks for multiple patches numbered 1/2 and 2/2.
